title: The Prophecy of Shaking and Zerubbabel's Signet Ring
description: In a final prophecy to Haggai, the Lord promises to shake heaven and earth, overthrow the thrones of kingdoms, and break the power of foreign nations. Chariots will be overturned, horses and riders will fall by each other's swords. On that day, the Lord will take Zerubbabel, his servant, and make him like a signet ring, for he is God's chosen one. [ref:Haggai 2:20-23|Haggai 2:20-23]
